name: theme-sisc
industry: education — private international school and college

source.engagement: Campus Electrical Network Integration and Smart Energy Management Project
source.deckAuthor: Argeo T. Alecha, Electrical Engineering Consultant
source.method: OOXML unpack — crest raster quantised in HSL, slide srgbClr frequency ranked across 24 slides, typeface and prstGeom census

a11ySafeText.note: Use these in place of the display values when the color carries small body text (<18pt regular / <14pt bold). Verified >=4.5:1 against background, surface and card.

webSubstitutes.note: Georgia, Arial and Courier New are system fonts, not webfonts. Arimo, Gelasio and Cousine are the metric-compatible Google-hosted equivalents — same advance widths, so layout does not reflow when they substitute.

conventions.kicker: Arial bold 18pt, letter-spacing +1.8pt, uppercase, color accent #D2650F

radiiRationale: sharp — the deck uses 509 rect shapes and 27 ellipses, zero roundRect

logo.realAssetNote: theme-sisc-logo.png is the client's actual horizontal lockup (badge + single-line wordmark), supplied by the user on 2026-08-19 as a screenshot — not the low-res crest embedded in the pptx. theme-sisc-logo-dark.png is a programmatic recolor of that same real asset (HSL-masked: flat blush background swapped to primary-800 #221433, wordmark violet swapped to primary-300 #B49ED1; the badge's own pixels are untouched — it carries a self-contained white card). The .svg files are hand-redrawn approximations of this real layout for use cases needing a vector — they are NOT a trace of the official crest.
logo.description: Heraldic shield crest — violet shield, purple name banner across the top in white type, white inner field, quartered diamond (violet star canton with 5 stars, maroon heart canton, green globe-with-figures base), motto FACITE DIFFERENTIAM in small type across the diamond seam, green laurel wreath, founding year 1990 at the base. Paired with a single-line serif small-caps wordmark in primaryLit violet.
